headline: OpenAI's first device is a ChatGPT smart speaker with camera, launching 2027
summary: OpenAI's first major hardware device will be a smart speaker with ChatGPT, a camera, and other sensors.
details: OpenAI is planning to release its first major hardware device, a smart speaker that lets users interact with ChatGPT. The device will feature a camera and additional sensors to understand its environment.

According to a report from Bloomberg, the smart speaker will have a rechargeable battery, allowing users to carry it with them. It will offer smart home controls, media playback, question answering, and message response.

The device is expected to launch in 2027, as part of OpenAI's plans for a larger hardware lineup, which currently includes around five devices. OpenAI is collaborating with former Apple designer Jony Ive on these new devices.
The company has also been teasing a Codex gadget called the Codex Micro, made in partnership with Work Louder, scheduled to release on July 15th.
caption:
OpenAI to launch its first device in 2027? It's a ChatGPT smart speaker with a camera!

OpenAI is planning to release its first major hardware device, a smart speaker that lets users interact with ChatGPT. The device will feature a camera and additional sensors to understand its environment.

According to a report from Bloomberg, the smart speaker will have a rechargeable battery, allowing users to carry it with them. It will offer smart home controls, media playback, question answering, and message response.

The device is expected to launch in 2027, as part of OpenAI's plans for a larger hardware lineup, which currently includes around five devices. OpenAI is collaborating with former Apple designer Jony Ive on these new devices.

The company has also been teasing a Codex gadget called the Codex Micro, made in partnership with Work Louder, scheduled to release on July 15th.
